featured_reviews.name: Devki Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Unprofessional – Worst Medical Store Experience

I’ve had a terrible experience with this medical store multiple times. They constantly send wrong medicines, and instead of apologizing or fixing their mistake politely, they blame the customer and even shout at us.

They are also extremely careless with delivery. Even after informing them many times about the correct address, they keep delivering to the wrong location, and then we have to waste our time calling them again and again to sort it out. It’s frustrating how much time and effort it takes to fix something that’s their fault.

They once kept calling me repeatedly just because I was five minutes late with an online payment, but when they mess up, there’s no urgency or responsibility on their part.

To make it worse, I’ve noticed they charge extra, and I’ve even received what seemed like fake or expired medicines. For a place dealing with health and people’s lives, this level of carelessness and arrogance is shocking.

Even though they claim to have customer support, it’s useless—no accountability at all.

Please do not trust this store for your medical needs. They are unreliable, rude, and highly unprofessional.
